title: The Winch and the Climbing Vine
story: A goat-herd family is stranded on a cliff ledge 96 feet above the valley, and Mr 6 works the rescue winch that lowers their basket 7 feet every minute. But Brambelash the Cliff Choker, a grumpy climbing vine, grabs the rope and hauls it back up 2.5 feet every minute. Mr 6 sits down on a rock, scratches numbers in the dust, and smiles.
question: At that steady tug-of-war, how many minutes will the basket take to travel all 96 feet down to the valley floor?
solution: Each minute the basket really drops 7 - 2.5 = 4.5 feet.
Time needed is 96 / 4.5 = 21.33 minutes (about 21 minutes and 20 seconds).
The basket reaches the valley in about 21.33 minutes.
praise: Dividing the distance by a speed was exactly the right plan — the missing step was subtracting the vine's 2.5-foot pull-back first.
hint: Before you divide, figure out the NET change in one minute: down 7, back up 2.5.
victory: Brambelash hauled with all its might and still watched the basket land safely, then sulked into a knot. 'You didn't beat my strength,' it groaned. 'No,' said Mr 6, 'I beat your arithmetic.'
imagePrompt: A brave numeral-six knight in a blue cape cranking a cliffside winch while a thick thorny vine yanks the rope upward, a basket of frightened goat-herds swinging over a sunlit green valley.
